header: A signed letter to the reader
bodytext:
Rich text at letter width, ending with a sign-off: an image, a name and a role. The image can be a scanned signature or a small portrait. It always appears below the text, never above, because a letter that opens with a face reads like a profile.

The sign-off image is sized by height, not width. A signature is wide and thin and a portrait is square, so a shared height gives both the same weight.

Use the note below the signature for the date, a version number or when a change takes effect.
author: Helene Marchetti
note: Written on 3 March 2026. The new opening hours apply from 1 April.
